(ns build
  (:require [clojure.tools.build.api :as b]))

(def class-dir "target/classes")
(def uber-file "target/kvhttp.jar")
(def basis (delay (b/create-basis {:project "deps.edn"})))

(defn clean [_]
  (b/delete {:path "target"}))

(defn uber [_]
  (clean nil)
  (b/copy-dir {:src-dirs ["src"] :target-dir class-dir})
  (b/compile-clj {:basis @basis
                  :ns-compile '[kvhttp.main]
                  :class-dir class-dir
                  :compiler-options {:direct-linking true}})
  (b/uber {:class-dir class-dir
           :uber-file uber-file
           :basis @basis
           :main 'kvhttp.main}))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an AOT-compiled uberjar and a launcher script at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

clojure -T:build uber

cat > app <<'LAUNCHER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
exec java -XX:+UseSerialGC -XX:TieredStopAtLevel=1 -Xss512k -Xshare:auto \
  -jar "$DIR/target/kvhttp.jar" "$@"
LAUNCHER
chmod +x app

(ns kvhttp.handler
  "Ring handler implementing the kvhttp routes."
  (:require [clojure.data.json :as json]
            [kvhttp.store :as store])
  (:import (java.io InputStream)))

(def ^:private key-pattern #"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}")

(def ^:private kv-prefix "/kv/")

(defn- response
  ([status] (response status nil))
  ([status body] {:status status :headers {} :body body}))

(def ^:private method-not-allowed (response 405))
(def ^:private not-found (response 404))

(defn- read-body
  ^bytes [{:keys [body]}]
  (cond
    (nil? body) (byte-array 0)
    (instance? InputStream body) (with-open [^InputStream in body] (.readAllBytes in))
    (string? body) (.getBytes ^String body "UTF-8")
    :else (byte-array 0)))

(defn- health [{:keys [request-method]}]
  (if (= :get request-method)
    (response 200 "ok")
    method-not-allowed))

(defn- list-keys [store {:keys [request-method]}]
  (if (= :get request-method)
    {:status 200
     :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
     :body (json/write-str (vec (store/list-keys store)))}
    method-not-allowed))

(defn- entry [store k {:keys [request-method] :as req}]
  (case request-method
    :get (if-some [v (store/fetch store k)]
           {:status 200
            :headers {"Content-Type" "application/octet-stream"}
            :body (java.io.ByteArrayInputStream. ^bytes v)}
           not-found)
    :put (case (store/put! store k (read-body req))
           :created (response 201)
           :replaced (response 200))
    :delete (if (store/delete! store k)
              (response 204)
              not-found)
    method-not-allowed))

(defn make-handler
  "Returns a Ring handler serving the kvhttp API from `store`."
  [store]
  (fn [{:keys [^String uri] :as req}]
    (cond
      (= uri "/health") (health req)
      (= uri "/kv") (list-keys store req)
      (.startsWith uri kv-prefix)
      (let [k (subs uri (count kv-prefix))]
        (if (re-matches key-pattern k)
          (entry store k req)
          (response 400)))
      :else not-found)))

(ns kvhttp.main
  "Entry point: `app <port>` serves the kvhttp API on 127.0.0.1:<port>."
  (:require [kvhttp.handler :as handler]
            [kvhttp.store :as store]
            [org.httpkit.server :as http])
  (:gen-class))

(def ^:private max-body-bytes
  "Values are capped at 1 MiB; leave headroom so oversized bodies are not cut mid-read."
  (* 8 1024 1024))

(defn- usage-exit []
  (binding [*out* *err*]
    (println "usage: app <port>"))
  (System/exit 2))

(defn- parse-port [s]
  (let [port (parse-long (str s))]
    (when (and port (< 0 port 65536)) port)))

(defn -main [& args]
  (let [port (or (some-> args first parse-port) (usage-exit))]
    (http/run-server (handler/make-handler (store/create))
                     {:ip "127.0.0.1"
                      :port port
                      :thread (max 8 (.availableProcessors (Runtime/getRuntime)))
                      :max-body max-body-bytes
                      :legacy-return-value? false})
    @(promise)))

(ns kvhttp.store
  "Thread-safe in-memory key-value store backed by an atom holding a sorted map.")

(defn create
  "Returns a new, empty store."
  []
  (atom (sorted-map)))

(defn fetch
  "Returns the value stored under `k`, or nil."
  [store k]
  (get @store k))

(defn put!
  "Stores `v` under `k`. Returns :created if the key was new, :replaced otherwise."
  [store k v]
  (let [[old _] (swap-vals! store assoc k v)]
    (if (contains? old k) :replaced :created)))

(defn delete!
  "Removes `k`. Returns true if the key was present."
  [store k]
  (let [[old _] (swap-vals! store dissoc k)]
    (contains? old k)))

(defn list-keys
  "Returns every key, sorted ascending."
  [store]
  (keys @store))
